summary: Regression testing on device selection checkboxes in ARGUS Center (client 86BIT_Office, tab Dispositivi). Tested checkbox behavior in grouped view, table view, select-all, bulk mark/unmark VITAL, and clear-selection. All flows work correctly with ZERO JS errors and ZERO ReferenceError (no 'Star is not defined'). No black-screen or modal-opening regression when clicking checkboxes.

detailed_results.grouped_view_deselect: PASS - Re-clicking first checkbox decrements to '1 selezionati'
